capabilities: Convert notes or heading levels into study cards
Run free checks and grade answers
extras: Prototype catalog/free-check keeps checks and history in memory only; progress is stored in Study Cards/data.json; macOS and iOS compatibility is unverified.
problem: Markdown notes are not easy to turn into self-testing flashcards with tracked progress and review of missed questions.

relations.evidence: Enable syncing of Other file types in Obsidian Sync and include the Study Cards folder.

summary: Flashcard tool that turns Markdown notes or headings into study cards, runs self-checks, retries missed questions, and tracks spaced repetition.
